selection.snapshot: first complete authorized capture in decision window after registration
selection.rank: highest minimum-reference probability EV; then point EV; then lexicographic contract/book identity
selection.duplicates: same operator aliases count once; choose one best offered eligible book per distinct contract
selection.abstention: no qualifying input means no selection; preserve reason and coverage

evaluation.primary_metric: hypothetical net units per resolved selected event; report unresolved coverage and cost stress
evaluation.uncertainty: event-level interval at fixed review; no independent-bet assumption
evaluation.validation: research only; no promotion from this pilot
